title: What's a Fishing Net Doing in a Tree?

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — WHAT'S THAT DOING HERE? (WD-01 to WD-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager's fishing net, left on the beach to dry, is draped across the top of a tall tree.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A whole fishing net is draped across the top of a tall tree at the edge of the village, spread out like washing. It's (subject)'s net. (subject) left it on the beach last night to dry. The beach is quite a long way from the tree. The net is quite a long way up.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) and (friend) spend most of the morning getting it down with long poles and a lot of muttering. When they finally untangle it, they find a small, very surprised bird caught gently in one corner. They free it, and it flies off, scolding. The net is fine. The tree is fine. Everyone is a bit out of breath.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) sits under the tree and thinks. A gust of wind? A very strong one, then. A prank? Nobody would be tall enough. (friend) suggests that maybe the net wanted to see the view. (subject) looks up at it, spread out over the leaves like a sail. It does look rather pleased with itself.
